zh-CN.title: 更可靠的版本更新
items: 升级前验证页面资源和服务进程，避免失败后反复刷新；支持上传升级诊断报告
修复侧栏、PWA 与第三方授权账号列表的头像缺失及刷新后退回文字占位的问题
精简时序插件说明，优化解绑按钮的布局与确认交互
支持 Chronelle 使用友间账号授权登录，仅共享个人资料
授权第三方应用读取个人资料时，可同步当前头像，兼容预设与自定义头像

en.title: More reliable updates
items: Updates verify resources and service workers before restarting, with diagnostic report uploads on failure
Fixed missing avatars and text placeholders after session refresh in the sidebar, PWA and authorization account lists
Simplified the Chronelle description and improved the unlink button and confirmation
Chronelle can now request Frienden sign-in with profile-only access
Authorized apps with profile access can now receive your current preset or custom avatar
